subject.title: Workspaces: persist widget state in SQLite

question: Should Workspaces permanently expose this state:persist manifest capability and versioned gateway/bridge contract to approved custom widgets?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but it creates a durable API and persistence boundary for untrusted agent-authored iframe code; repository automation cannot decide that long-term security and compatibility contract.

options.title: Approve after proof
options.body: Accept the proposed parent-bound, capability-gated SQLite contract after current-head browser proof is posted and the canonical issue reference is corrected.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Limit persistence initially to trusted built-in widgets or a private host accessor, deferring the public custom-widget capability until its API is finalized.

options.title: Pause write-back
options.body: Keep custom widgets read-only and close or defer this direction if the additional durable security surface is not currently wanted.

recommendation.title: Approve after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed parent-bound, capability-gated SQLite contract after current-head browser proof is posted and the canonical issue reference is corrected.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Workspaces architecture and its plugin, storage, gateway, and iframe security boundaries were integrated in their merged foundation work.
